{c_important}Basic{/c} Skills generate {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 1"]{/c} additional Primary Resource, once per Skill.

{c_important}Basic{/c} Skills deal {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|2%x|]{/c} increased damage for each point of Primary Resource you have, up to {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 2"]{/c} Resource.
{c_important}Basic{/c} Skills generate additional resource and deal {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|%x2|]{/c} increased damage for each point of Primary Resource you have.
